interpretation.anchor_selection: reference, c44-1gpa and SiC-derived-rates were predefined comparison cases. Their reductions are not optimizer contributions.
interpretation.event_scope: Primary-count precision is conditional on fixed source positions. Increasing primaries cannot remove source integration uncertainty.
interpretation.material_scope: SiC-derived-rates is a model case with assumed rates, not a demonstrated ranking of real materials.
interpretation.nested_comparison: 512-site estimates in the nested contrast use the subset of the 1024-site run with matched streams, not the separate source-512 study.
interpretation.sampling: Scrambled Sobol positions outside junctions; independent layout means directly measure variance across that sampling procedure. Per-layout hierarchical intervals instead treat sites exchangeably within each region.
interpretation.site_cap: 1024 is the user chosen maximum, not evidence of spatial convergence.
interpretation.source_spatial_reason: Nested global and regional intervals and retained-layout agreement intervals do not fit within declared 5 percent equivalence limits. Four independent-layout means themselves pass the 2 percent RSE criterion. Global shifts are small; insufficient equivalence precision is not proof of a large global bias.

SiC-derived-rates.limitation: Sites are treated as exchangeable within each region, with fixed area weights. Independent randomized position layouts are required to assess integration uncertainty and layout bias.

next_analysis_without_transport.action: Recompute balanced 512-site subsets of each existing independent 1024-site layout, retaining first half of sites in each region. Compare 1024 minus 512 using the four independent paired layout differences.
Estimate within-region site spreads from archived measurements and plan allocation n_h proportional to W_h sigma_h subject to total sites<=1024 and per-junction coverage. Do not change area weights.

objective.definition: J=sum_h W_h mean_i,r(b_i,r), b_i,r=sum_e a_e N_i,r,e/(n_primary E_gun)
objective.uncertainty: SE is one standard error; RSE=SE/abs(J). Independent-layout intervals are Student-t with three degrees of freedom.

proposed_next_experiments_not_launched: If independent paired spatial intervals remain too broad, use additional independently scrambled layouts of at most 1024 sites rather than more primaries at identical sites.
Use 512 sites and modest primary counts for optimizer comparisons, then independently check finalists on 1024 sites; report separate search and confirmation results.
Use identical objective, physical bounds, evaluation counts and time limits for random or Sobol sampling, Bayesian optimization and CMA-ES, with repeated independent searches.
